skill.summary: Fetch professional stock market data from Yahoo Finance (yfinance) and SEC EDGAR. Use when: user asks about stock prices, market data, company financials, ea...

latestVersion.changelog:
finance-data 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Fetches professional stock and financial data from Yahoo Finance (yfinance) and SEC EDGAR.
- Supports real-time quotes, historical prices, full company profiles, financial statements, holders, analyst recommendations, dividends, options chains, earnings, and news.
- Provides comprehensive SEC filings search, full-text filing reading with section extraction, filing document index, and company metadata.
- Enables access to structured financial data (XBRL concepts) and insider transactions.
- Compatible with US stocks, Chinese A-shares, and major international markets.
